messages:
marta: Quick sync 1 need a single, punchy hero for launch. Must read for engineers and buying teams; route Hosted vs Enterprise clearly.

ken: Keep headline <12 words and mode-agnostic. put modes in subhead or pills. Draft: "Production LLM inference, predictable at scale."

drew: I like it. subhead: "Start with our Hosted API or move to Dedicated and Private with the same API and controls."

asha: UX: 3 micro-CTAs under hero as pills: Try hosted | Enterprise capacity | See benchmarks. Each routes differently.

marta: Routing plan: 
  - Try hosted -> /signup?utm=hero_launch&utm_mode=hosted -> Growth onboarding queue
  - Enterprise capacity -> /contact-enterprise?utm=hero_launch&utm_mode=enterprise -> enterprise form + AE alert
  - See benchmarks -> /benchmarks?utm=hero_launch&utm_mode=benchmarks -> content funnel

ken: Pill microcopy options: 
  Hosted: "Start instantly 1 free credits"
  Dedicated: "Reserved GPU capacity + SLA"
  Private: "VPC/on-prem & KMS for regulated data"

drew: Add a tiny 3-bullet proof row below pills (no hard claims):
  - "Caching and batching reduced customer token spend while respecting latency SLOs."
  - "Smart routing provides graceful fallbacks during capacity events."
  - "Per-route observability for cost and latency trade-offs."

asha: Webinar tie-in: 40m tech talk + 15m Q&A. Title draft: "Serving LLMs in Production: latency, cost, and resilience". Social copy short: "Join our engineers for practical patterns on serving LLMs. Wed May 6 1 register: <link>"

marta: Enterprise form fields: company name, role, company size, expected peak qps, cloud provider, compliance needs, checkbox: "Request capacity planning call" -> flags AE.

ken: Tracking shorthand for engineers: 
  Try hosted: /signup?utm_campaign=hero_launch&utm_mode=hosted
  Contact enterprise: /contact?utm_campaign=hero_launch&utm_mode=enterprise
  Webinar: /events/serve-llms?utm_campaign=webinar_hero

drew: A/B idea: Variant A headline = "Production LLM inference, predictable at scale"; Variant B headline = "Ship LLM features with consistent latency and cost". Keep modes out of headline.

asha: I'll mock mobile-first Figma frames and pill states (hover, active).

marta: I'll run a short copy sprint tomorrow 10am PT to finalize headline, pills, and the webinar blurb. Copybot: remind ops.

pm-bot: Reminder scheduled: "Copy sprint - hero & pill routing" tomorrow 10:00 PT. :bell:

marta: Thanks all 1 see you at the sprint. :thumbsup:
